Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

MRI of the left knee is within normal limits.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Right knee pain, worse with planting.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body, with inferiorly surfacing oblique tear. Intrasubstance degeneration within the posterior horn and anterior horn without additional tear is. The posterior root is intact.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

Medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact.

The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact. 

No patellofemoral subluxation. Suspected partial-thickness tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact no femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is thinning of articular cartilage overlying the medial patellar facet with focal full thickness cartilage denuding. There is generalized thinning of trochlear articular cartilage. There is generalized thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage with focal areas of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the medial femoral condyle. There is thinning of articular cartilage overlying the lateral tibial plateau.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Superficial varicosities at the posterior medial aspect of the knee.

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly subtle tear involving the medial meniscal body without new meniscal extrusion.
2. Suspected partial-thickness tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament without patellofemoral subluxation.
3. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
4. Tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment consistent with moderate medial compartment predominant osteoarthritis of right knee.

МР находка: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни промени на дясната колянна става. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е износен изцяло. Изобразява се костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура и тибията. МР данни за големи остеофити по ставните повърхности на медиалните кондили на фемура и тибията. Сравнително по-малки остеофити се визуалиизрат по ставните краища от латералната страна. Наличе на малък ставен излив. Медиалният менискус е дегенеративно променен и е фрагментиран в областта на задния рог. Медиалният менискус е с висок сигнален интензитет, като голяма част от него е изместена навън от ставната междина. До менискуса и свързана с него се изобразява голяма, мултилокуларна киста с размер около 50мм. Кистата измества встрани ставната капсула. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна на ставата е сравнително запазен. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. МР данни за хондромалация на пателата – 3-та степен. Патела бипартита. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Вижда се малка Бекерова киста в поплитеалната ямка. Заключение: МР данни за гонартрозни промени, изразени от медиалната страна на ставата. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия на медиалния менискус. Голяма киста на медиалния менискус. Хондромалация на пателата – 3-та степен. Малък ставен излив. Малка Бекерова киста.

Stable looking undersurface horizontal tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with no accompanying medial meniscal extrusion of note, nor is there any involvement of the corresponding posterior root and ligament.

An undisplaced degenerative tear of the free edge of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is again seen, together with lateral meniscal body extrusion.

Focal full-thickness articular cartilage loss noted at the junction between the central and posterior thirds of the lateral femoral condyle, with no accompanying fracture lines or mass lesions, nor any articular surface collapse.

Generalized thinning of medial and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage damage, with focal grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss being centred on the median ridge of the patella.

Moderate suprapatellar effusion, there are no intra-articular bodies.
A high-riding patella is also noted, together with patellofemoral incongruity and subtle superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement - the patellar lateralization present is not deemed secondary to the underlying effusion.

Small, non ruptured Baker's cyst noted posteromedially.

Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, extensor tendons, distal iliotibial band and popliteus musculotendinous unit.

No other skeletal abnormality of note.
Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Medial and lateral meniscal pathology, age commensurate tricompartmental articular degenerative changes, multifactorial extensor mechanism abnormalities.

posterior de platillo tibial lateral y de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral con pequeña
fractura subcortical regional.
Signos de un esguince de bajo grado del ligamento colateral lateral. Edema de las partes blandas
adyacentes.
Moderado derrame articular con leve sinovitis. Laminar cantidad de liquido intermuscular en la
región poplítea

SOL  DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların bütünlüğü, sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküs sinyal intensitesi ve bütünlüğü doğaldır. Popliteal fossada yer işgal eden lezyon saptanmadı.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Вижда се контузионен костномозъчен едем в пателата в долен полюс. Няма дани за фрактура на пателата. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е интактен. Предна кърстана връзка се представя със задебелен напречник и повишен сигнален интензитет, промените могат да се свържат с частично минимално скъсване. Задна кръстна връзка е със запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на двата менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Заключение: МР данни контузионен косто-мозъчен едем в пателата. Частично, минимално скъсване на предна кръстна връзка.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Légère chondropatie des compartiments médial et latéral portants avec changements de signal mais sans fissuration profonde.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Léger épaississement proximal compatible avec des séquelles d'entorse ancienne de bas grade.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Amas de calcifications millimétriques du côté postérieur médial de la partie proximale du condyle fémoral médial, situé en partie dans et autour de l'origine dorsale la plus proximale du ligament collatéral médial, et juste en médial du bord médial de l'origine du gastrocnémien médial. Il y a un œdème des tissus mous environnants.

CONCLUSION :
Petit amas de calcifications avec œdème réactionnel des tissus mous en arrière du condyle fémoral médial associé à l'origine postérieure du ligament collatéral médial et à proximité du bord médial de l'origine du muscle/tendon gastrocnémien médial. Il s'agit très probablement d'un dépôt d'hydroxyapatite accompagné d'une inflammation réactionnelle, probablement la source de la douleur. Pour la corrélation clinique, une injection de corticostéroïdes pourrait être réalisée sous guidage échographique si nécessaire.
Pas de signe de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL normal. MCL normal. Medial meniscus tear. Lateral meniscus normal. OA of all three compartments. Baker's cyst with synovitis. Pes anserinus bursitis. Large effusion with synovitis. Conclusion: Medial meniscus tear. OA of all three compartments. Baker's cyst with synovitis. Pes anserinus bursitis.
